alt: 左邊完整畫面中，大人拉住快靠近深坑的孩子；右邊有人只展示拉扯衣袖的局部照片，旁觀者看後皺眉。
scene_prompt: Create a very clear two-panel visual comparison, separated by wide ivory space, entirely without writing. Left larger panel: full scene of an adult pulling a child back from the edge of an uncovered deep hole; the adult grips the child sleeve while the child is startled, the hole clearly visible and the rescue unmistakable. Right smaller panel: a manipulative person holds a rectangular cropped photograph showing ONLY the same adult gripping the startled child sleeve; the dangerous hole and rescue context are excluded outside the photo crop. One observer seeing only the cropped photo frowns accusingly. Same clothing and poses connect both images. The full rescue remains clearly the true original context. No scissors near people, no letters, no bubbles.
